original_requirement: Read exactly three bytes: low, high and reading. Read all three before any check. Reject low greater than high as WINDOW at low; otherwise reject reading below low as BELOW at reading, then reject reading above high as ABOVE at reading. Perform trailing-data rejection last. Return reading as UInt16BE.
